policy.acceptance: Observation only; existing structural and forward contracts unchanged
policy.atom_origin: Heavy elements and explicitly labelled isotopes require a listed source
policy.conditions: Excluded; contextual feasibility and selectivity remain unresolved
policy.contexts: RDChiral source context plus exact precursor replay; analogy only
policy.mapping: Auxiliary; require exact complete input binding and valid atom provenance
policy.precedent: Exact full identities and precursor occurrences; no missing-match rejection
policy.stoichiometry: Unknown; counts alone cannot reject when coefficients are absent

protocol.constraints: No checker access to labels or scorer-generated fields. No final-outcome tuning. Record classifier policy hash before final scoring. Existing 14 user-selected routes are development cases only.
protocol.duplicate_policy: Preserve raw rows; score each full identity-v1 reaction once; conflicting expert labels are reference conflicts, not binary truth
protocol.final_evidence_exclusion: Exclude exact final-reference reaction identities from operational precedent evidence during evaluation; never insert benchmark reactions or labels into knowledge indexes
protocol.grouping: RDKit canonical product constitution with isomericSmiles=False, used only for split grouping; identity-v1 stays unchanged for all matching
protocol.reference_kind: Expert-labelled model proposals; not experimental success/failure records
protocol.scope: New reaction-level evaluation; existing planner and forward verification protocols unchanged
protocol.split: sha256('ChemLab-chemical-reference-2026-10-31:' + grouping_key) modulo 5; remainder 4 final_reference; others development
